versions.changelog:
April Fools virtual pet prank — you adopt a digital creature that really needs care.

- Adopt a virtual pet as an April Fools joke, but the pet needs real-time care and can die permanently from neglect.
- Features 64+ species, 5 evolution stages, and dynamic care requirements with real consequences.
- Real-time hunger, health, happiness, and discipline systems; every action affects your pet’s life.
- Missed feedings lead to visible public gravestones on the permanent graveyard.
- Playfully designed for April Fools, but your virtual pet’s survival depends on your actual engagement.
